# mongodb.com documentation

> This section shows how to set up a local or cloud MongoDB Atlas deployment and connect to the deployment by using the MongoDB Shell.

Generated from a mirror of mongodb.com by docset_refine on the hub; 82 pages. Companion files: llms-full.txt (all pages), llms-small.txt (reference pages within ~50k tokens), llms-facts.txt (extracted units).
